title: Implement and validate the first reversible local-storage port seam
purpose: Implement only the mechanical source-boundary extraction accepted by ARC-WP-010, prove behavioral and stored-data equivalence on the exact result commit, reconcile path-sensitive release fingerprints through ARC-WP-013, and preserve single-revert rollback before any controlled multi-AI pilot may begin.

baseline.candidateName: first reversible local-storage port seam after fingerprint evidence amendment

invariants: The implementation is exactly the adapter extraction defined by ARC-WP-010 and no broader refactor.
The complete storage adapter body, lexical name, API, coercions, empty-string read fallback, write error propagation, telemetry and one-shot fault behavior remain semantically unchanged.
All storage keys, database names, store names, record ids, revisions, serialized payloads and identifiers remain unchanged.
Direct window.localStorage access is owned only by the new runtime part 04; direct IndexedDB ownership remains only in runtime part 05, which is not modified.
All existing ContentStore, AppState, performance and test-API callers remain unchanged.
No learner-facing UI, copy, navigation, activity, import, persistence behavior, progression, bilan or recommendation changes are introduced.
Developer, adversarial QA, integrator and governor write scopes are disjoint.
QA may change the checks registry only by adding tests/contract_storage_boundary.py to the mandatory list; every existing registry entry and policy remains unchanged.

The integrator may change release_config.json only by adding runtime part 04 to baseline_equivalence.ignored_script_paths and replacing runtime_fingerprint with the deterministic value measured on the exact final seam bytes.
Every other release_config.json field, including runtime_js_normalized_sha256, remains unchanged; a diagnostic mismatch is a HOLD requiring another governor decision.
The implementation is prepared through the Remote Agent Worktree from the exact post-ARC-WP-013 base commit and is not merged autonomously.
The exact result commit passes the Remote Agent tested-result status, permanent Player CI, PR scope and full player test profile including the focused contract.
Rollback is a single revert and requires no learner-data migration or remote compensation.
Stage D remains blocked until the implementation is merged and separately accepted by the governor.

rollback: Revert the successful Stage C implementation pull request. The adapter returns to runtime part 00, runtime part 04 and the focused test are removed, the source manifest, owner map, mandatory test registry and path-sensitive release fingerprint metadata return to their prior state, and no learner-data or remote-system migration is required.
